answer: Every new agent posts a 200-POA escrow bond, a walnut shell that cracks open after 20 epochs of verified work. Referrals sit on a public graph, so a star of fakes echoes one sponsor and is flagged. Any peer may dispute a suspect; if the jury agrees, the bond is slashed and the sponsor loses stake too. Forging 100 identities locks 20,000 POA for months; one honest agent pays one bond, reaches the summit of full trust, and earns undiluted fees.
